Modernists.readme:
MODERNISTS v1 - AUTHOR ORNAMENTS
James Joyce and Virginia Woolf, bundled with OrbitUI from alpha.14.

OrbitUI installs this folder once into:
koreader/settings/bookshelf/ornaments/Modernists/

The enabled busts stand immediately before a matching author's book or run
of books. A run continuing onto a new page gets its bust there too. They
are never placed randomly among other authors or on an empty shelf.
Matching uses book author metadata, not filenames or title substrings.
Both "James Joyce" and "Joyce, James" work (likewise Virginia Woolf).
Missing or ambiguous metadata is not guessed. Narrow shelves may omit a
bust when there is not enough room for the bust and its book together.

The Ornament collection browser has a Modernists tab. Existing per-piece,
pack and shelf on/off choices are respected. Setting the shelf's ornament
frequency to None also disables these busts. Otherwise a matching run gets
one bust, independently of the frequency pattern for ordinary ornaments.
Tap a bust on a shelf to zoom and see its source information; long-press to
change size, padding or height. Existing user files are not overwritten,
and deleted ornaments or packs are not automatically restored.

If you installed the earlier Modernists-Preview trial pack, its two busts
are also author-matched. The released pack wins when both copies are on,
so the same author is not decorated twice.

Two 1024 x 1536 RGBA PNGs, with original generated alpha and provenance.
Scale/lift defaults align their visible heights and compensate for bottom
padding. If you change the scale, you may need to adjust height as well.
These are AI-adapted prototypes, not documentary photos or museum scans.
Generated with Codex's built-in image generation tool; prompts.json records
the inputs. Sources and attribution are in ATTRIBUTION.txt.

ARTWORK LICENSES (separate from OrbitUI's code license):
James Joyce.png: CC BY-SA 4.0.
Virginia Woolf.png: CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, non-commercial use only.
Keep the attribution and license notices when redistributing the images.
The two separately licensed images form a collection, not a combined work.

Authors.readme:
AUTHORS v1 - AUTHOR-MATCHED SHELF ORNAMENTS
Nine additional busts for OrbitUI:
August Strindberg, Stanislaw Lem, Dylan Thomas, Thomas Mann, Fyodor Dostoevsky,
Knut Hamsun, Clarice Lispector, Robert Musil and Franz Kafka.

Installed once from the bundled runtime into:
koreader/settings/bookshelf/ornaments/Authors/

This separate pack adds to Modernists without changing the Joyce/Woolf images,
user adjustments, disabled pieces, or previously deleted files/packs.
Each pack has its own one-time installation marker. Interrupted copies retry
on next startup; existing files are not overwritten. Deleting this pack after
installation does not cause a later startup to restore it.

Enabled busts appear before the first book in the matching author's run,
including page starts. They never enter the ordinary random ornament deck.
Matching uses full author metadata, including inverted surnames, not titles or
filenames. Lem's accented and ASCII spellings both work. Swedish Dostojevskij
and common English Dostoevsky/Dostoyevsky forms are also supported.
No match is guessed from a multi-book folder's representative.

Find the pack in Wallpaper, ornaments and colours > Ornament collection > Authors.
Tap a bust to zoom and read its origin. Long-press for scale, padding and height.
Shelf frequency None, pack disable and per-piece disable remain effective.
A narrow row shrinks or omits the bust rather than separating it from its book.

Nine 1024 x 1536 RGBA PNGs. Original generated bytes, alpha and provenance
are preserved. Small scale/lift adjustments align their visible heights and
plinths; no per-page network calls or image generation are involved.
prompts.json contains the exact prompts and source metadata.
ATTRIBUTION.txt records the separate image licenses and modifications.
Dostoevsky is NON-COMMERCIAL ONLY (CC BY-NC-SA 4.0); Lem is CC BY-SA 4.0.
The remaining adaptations/original interpretations are CC BY 4.0 to the extent
applicable, not documentary reproductions or endorsements.

Older OrbitUI versions that do not know this pack may place it randomly.
Disable Authors before rolling back to alpha.14 or earlier if that is unwanted.
